description: Bundle everything an agent needs to fix one bug in a single call: a paste-ready fixPrompt (plain-English diagnosis + reproduction + suggested fix + relevant code + blast radius), plus report detail, repro steps, component, root cause, ontology tags, and the inventory action (with its expected_outcome contract) the report is filed against, plus recipe: a ≤4 KB excerpt with the app's tokens (CSS var / TS names), the design deviance score and deviance findings in the files this fix touches, so the fix uses the app's tokens instead of literals, and recipe.context: the tables the stack trace names with their columns from the latest schema snapshot (and any it says do not exist), whether the last merged fix is live, and the open hole-check findings, each section with its own state and note. Returns { report, fixPrompt, reproductionSteps, component, rootCause, bugOntologyTags, inventoryAction, recipe }; recipe is always { state, note, … } with state ok | drift | unknown | not_connected | error, never null. Read-only; no second LLM key needed. Use before writing a fix; use triage_issue for a multi-report review packet, or suggest_fix for just the Stage-2 hint.

projectId.description: Project UUID — required for org-scoped keys with multiple projects. (`project_id` is accepted too.)

reportId.description: The report UUID to fix (`report_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_fix_context

component.description: Component or page the bug was attributed to

fixPrompt.description: Paste-ready fix prompt composed server-side, or null

inventoryAction.description: The inventory action (with its expected_outcome contract) the report is filed against, or null

recipe.description: Design excerpt (≤ 4 KB) for the report's project: tokens with CSS var / TS names, the deviance score, findings in the files this fix touches, and context (tables the stack trace names, whether the last fix is live, open hole checks). Never null; when it could not be read, { state: 'error', note }.

context.description: Backend and release context for this bug; each section has its own state, and unknown never means healthy

deploy.description: { state: live | deployed_since_merge | not_live | probe_failed | unknown | no_merged_fix | error, note, lastFix, targets }

radar.description: { state, note, checkedAt, findings: [{ rule, severity, message, fix }] }: open hole checks

schema.description: { state, note, snapshotAt, tables: [{ name, columns }], missing }: tables the stack trace names, from the latest schema snapshot

findings.description: Open design deviance findings in the files this fix touches

note.description: Why this state, in plain English

score.description: Design deviance score 0–100, lower is better; null = not scored

set.description: The token set the excerpt was taken from

state.description: ok | drift | unknown | not_connected | error; unknown never means healthy

tokens.description: Most useful tokens first: { path, value, cssVar, ts }. Use these names, not literals.

truncated.description: True when the excerpt was cut to stay under 4 KB

component.description: Component or page the bug was attributed to

console_logs.description: Console entries captured with the report

inventory_action.description: Inventory action the report is filed against, when resolved

network_logs.description: Network requests captured with the report

status.description: Workflow status, e.g. new, classified, fixing, fixed, verified, reopened

summary.description: One-line summary written by the classifier

reproductionSteps.description: Reproduction steps recorded on the report ([] if none)

rootCause.description: Stage-2 root cause, or null before Stage 2 runs

title: Fix context bundle
